scope: Finite Hilbert-space averaging over the 322560 Weyl chambers in K1314, before any claim that the average is invariant under the chamber-dependent G actions.

construction.multichamber_space: direct sum over chambers C of H_C with H_C=L2(K/M)
construction.reference_identification: one declared unitary identification U_C:H_0->H_C per chamber
construction.average_projection: P=(1/|W|) J J* where J(v)=(U_C v)_C

claim_ceiling: Exact orthogonal projection on the finite chamber-indexed Hilbert sum after declared unitary fiber identifications. It removes raw chamber multiplicity only as Hilbert linear algebra and does not establish G-equivariance, analytic intertwiner coherence, source selection or physical descent.
